official: 神奈川県地域未来基金条例
name: 地域産業の育成に使う基金を設置
summary: 県が、産業の育成などに使う「神奈川県地域未来基金」を設けます。基金には予算で決めた額を積み立て、重点的に育てる産業分野の事業や、地場産業の成長を促す事業に充てます。
changes: 重点的に育成する産業分野の事業と地場産業の成長を促す事業に基金を充てる
基金の積立額を予算で定める
基金の運用益を一般会計の予算に計上して基金に加える
財政上必要な場合、基金の現金を歳計現金に繰り替えて運用する
who: 重点的に育成する産業分野や地場産業の事業者
why: 基金の設置や管理、処分に必要な事項を定めるためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Creates a fund to support local industry development
en.official: Kanagawa Prefecture Regional Future Fund Ordinance
en.summary: The prefecture will establish the “Kanagawa Prefecture Regional Future Fund” to support industry development and other purposes. It will add to the fund an amount set in the budget and use it for projects in industry fields selected for priority development and projects that promote the growth of local industries.
changes: Uses the fund for projects in industry fields selected for priority development and projects that promote the growth of local industries
Sets the amount to be added to the fund in the budget
Includes the fund’s investment earnings in the general account budget and adds them to the fund
When needed for financial reasons, temporarily transfers the fund’s cash to cash for budget execution and manages it
who: Businesses in industry fields selected for priority development and local industries
en.why: The prefecture says this is to set out the matters needed for establishing, managing and disposing of the fund.
